I sent her the files and asked if she needed anything else since I was going to the doctor and wouldn't be bringing my laptop with me. She said that was all for now. I went to the doctor, who told me I was overworked because I'd been working overtime until 2-3 AM for the past two months and needed some rest. On my way home, my senior associate texted me again, asking for the client's billing information, something she could have done herself since she has their contacts. I forwarded her the information as she asked. When I got home, I took the prescribed medicine and fell asleep. However, depending on the company's culture and policies, there might be different expectations about being available to handle work-related matters, even while sick. In this case, my senior associate seemed to have a lot of work that she needed help with, and she kept reaching out to me even though I was supposed to be resting. I also need to think about the potential consequences of ignoring her texts. I should also reflect on whether there were alternative ways to handle the situation.
